# Speech Typing

> > Free online speech-to-text, voice typing, and audio conversion tools with support for 100+ languages and neural voices.

Speech Typing is a comprehensive browser-based platform offering free speech recognition, voice dictation, and audio conversion services. The site supports multiple languages including English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Russian, Japanese, Chinese, Arabic, and Korean, making it accessible to a global audience.

## Core Speech-to-Text Tools

- [Speech Typing - Free Online Speech to Text & Voice Typing](https://www.speech-typing.com): Homepage for Speech Typing, free speech-to-text and voice typing tool
- [Best Voice to Text Online Converter Tool](https://www.speech-typing.com/p/voice-to-text.html): Voice-to-text converter with live transcription and dictation
- [Free Speech to Text in All Languages](https://www.speech-typing.com/p/speech-to-text-in-all-languages.html): Multilingual speech-to-text converter supporting all languages
- [Unlimited Free Audio & Video to Text converter | Speech Typing](https://www.speech-typing.com/p/audio-video-to-text-converter.html): Audio and video file transcription converter for speech-to-text

## Audio & Voice Tools

- [Unlimited Free Text to Audio Converter 2025 | Speech Typing](https://www.speech-typing.com/p/text-to-audio.html): Text-to-Audio converter with 100+ neural voices and MP3 download
- [Free Online Text Reader | Read Text Aloud Naturally](https://www.speech-typing.com/p/text-reader.html): Text reader with 100+ neural voices for natural audio synthesis
- [Free Online Voice Recorder - Record audio from microphone](https://www.speech-typing.com/p/voice-recorder.html): Free online voice recorder with microphone input and MP3 download
